description: Searches Overflow Design's drawings by what they show: 1,120 icons, 457 illustrations and 354 isometric drawings, and 20 bot avatars for AI agents. Use it when the user wants an icon, an illustration, an isometric drawing or a face for an AI agent. Every word of the query must match a drawing's name or tags, and "icon", "illustration" or "isometric" in the query narrows the search to that set. Avatars appear when the query names the animal or says avatar, agent, bot or mascot, or when the set is avatars. Returns each match's id, name, set, category and page link, and marks the drawings this connection cannot fetch because they need an Overflow Pro licence.

category.description: Only this category, by its slug or its label.

query.description: What the drawing should show, in plain words. Empty with a set or category to browse it.

tier.description: free for drawings anybody can fetch, pro for the ones that need Pro.
